trait.mattermod.excavation.momentum.desc: Mining builds [color=#E99F20]Pressure[/color]; each stage mines faster.
trait.mattermod.excavation.steady_hand.d: Held blocks lock to the grid, preview where they land and are set down exactly as shown.
trait.mattermod.excavation.common_collec: Drops from blocks you break fly to you.
trait.mattermod.excavation.vein_miner.de: Mine whole ore veins at once. See nearby ores through walls.
trait.mattermod.excavation.mass_pickup.d: Lift a whole group of blocks at once.
trait.mattermod.combat.lock_on.desc: [color=#E99F20]Pressure[/color] locks your beam onto its target.
trait.mattermod.combat.arc.desc: [color=#E99F20]Pressure[/color] chains your beam to nearby enemies.
trait.mattermod.combat.disrupt.desc: Sustained contact weakens armour and disables shields.
trait.mattermod.orb.marksman.desc: Stand still while charging for faster shots.
trait.mattermod.orb.detonator.desc: Press the same button again to burst your projectile.
trait.mattermod.orb.seeker.desc: Projectiles home in on the enemy you aimed near.
trait.mattermod.hydraulics.badge.desc: Unlocks [color=#2074E9]Hydraulic Mode[/color]: aim-steered water blob (left click) and ice shard (right click). Swim faster.
trait.mattermod.hydraulics.pressure.desc: Water placed against a block stays as a source.
trait.mattermod.hydraulics.rapids.desc: Water shots over water raise a surge 2/4/6 wide that carries boats and creatures.
trait.mattermod.hydraulics.common_slipst: Water and Frost shots lose no range underwater.
trait.mattermod.hydraulics.tidecaller.de: Ride a fully charged Water shot.
trait.mattermod.hydraulics.diving_bell.d: Water and Frost shots carve air tunnels through water.
trait.mattermod.pyrotechnics.badge.desc: Unlocks [color=#E95C20]Pyrotechnic Mode[/color]: molten glob (left click), fire seed (right click). Immune to fire and lava. Ignite shots fuel furnaces.
trait.mattermod.pyrotechnics.inferno.des: Lava placed against a block stays as a source. Elsewhere it cools after 8s.
trait.mattermod.pyrotechnics.wildfire.de: Your fire spreads through flammable terrain.
trait.mattermod.pyrotechnics.flashover.d: Hitting a burning enemy ignites those nearby.
trait.mattermod.pyrotechnics.phoenix.des: Survive a fatal hit in a burst of fire. Once every 10 min.
trait.mattermod.pyrotechnics.soulwake.de: Your burns become soulfire. Enemies it kills rise as an allied Soulfire Blazeling.
trait.mattermod.pneumatic.badge.desc: Unlocks [color=#20E9C1]Gust Mode[/color]: push and disarm. Shots recoil; slammed mobs take damage. Double jump.
trait.mattermod.pneumatic.gale_force.des: Charge boosts Gust knockback, yours too. Hit enemies take more fall damage.
trait.mattermod.pneumatic.common_feather: No fall damage. Hold Jump to fall slowly.
trait.mattermod.pneumatic.bunny_hop.desc: Jump right as you land to build speed. Hold Jump to keep hopping.
trait.mattermod.pneumatic.ground_slam.de: Sneak to charge a jump. Sneak in the air to slam down, harder the further you fell.
trait.mattermod.pneumatic.common_air_con: Better steering in the air, without braking.
trait.mattermod.pneumatic.stasis.desc: Freeze enemies briefly. Knockback piles up and lands all at once when they thaw.
trait.mattermod.pneumatic.rebound.desc: Gusted enemies bounce off walls and each other.
trait.mattermod.photonic.badge.desc: Unlocks [color=#E9C820]Light Mode[/color]. You glow, lighting nearby players too. Light shots bounce twice, leaving a light at each bounce.
trait.mattermod.photonic.flare.desc: Light projectiles reveal nearby entities through walls.
trait.mattermod.photonic.radiance.desc: Light shots heal you and nearby allies (doesn't stack).
trait.mattermod.photonic.common_lumen_tr: Sneak to see the path you walked.
trait.mattermod.photonic.daybreak.desc: Light shots scare darkness-loving mobs and burn them up close.
trait.mattermod.photonic.mirage.desc: Light shots leave a decoy of you where they end.
trait.mattermod.photonic.common_clear_si: Night Vision. Immune to Blindness and Darkness.
trait.mattermod.photonic.constellation.d: Bounce lights link up, spreading their effects. Mirage leaves a decoy at each.
trait.mattermod.photonic.supernova.desc: The last impact releases one big Light pulse. Mirage decoys last longer.
trait.mattermod.mechatronic.badge.desc: Summons the [color=#E92031]Redstone Monstrosity[/color]: it draws enemies within 12 blocks. Left click a creature to attack, a block to hold; Sneak to follow. Rebuilt 60s after breaking down.
trait.mattermod.mechatronic.piston_arm.d: Super Move: a two-fist piston slam, 14 damage within 4 blocks in front. Cooldown 6s.
trait.mattermod.mechatronic.dispenser_ar: Super Move: a homing bolt from each arm cannon, 6 damage each. Cooldown 5s.
trait.mattermod.mechatronic.redstone_fur: Blows charge it up. Full charge Overcharges it for 6s: a Cube Field blocks projectiles, +50% speed and damage, much stronger knockback.
trait.mattermod.mechatronic.ministrositi: Overcharging raises 3 Ministrosities from the ground to fight beside it.
trait.mattermod.mechatronic.supercharged: While Overcharged, its blows arc to up to 3 more enemies within 5 blocks for 5 damage each, and it takes 30% less damage.
trait.mattermod.mechatronic.saddle.desc: Right click it to ride. Left click: lift. Right click: Super Move. Hold Jump to charge a jump (a slamming leap while galloping); Jump in the air to rocket.
trait.mattermod.mechatronic.rocket_boots: Rockets burn longer and climb harder: 2.4s of thrust.
trait.mattermod.mobility.badge.desc: Unlocks [color=#9520E9]Tether Mode[/color]: left click hooks, right click reels (tap: all the way, hold: while held). Jump to let go at speed. Move 10% faster.
trait.mattermod.mobility.blink.desc: Double-tap right click while hooked to teleport to the hook.
trait.mattermod.mobility.gravity_shift.d: Double-tap right click while hooked to make that surface your floor.
trait.mattermod.mobility.skyhook.desc: Tether shots that miss anchor in empty air.
trait.mattermod.mobility.zipline.desc: Link two surfaces with a rope you can ride.
trait.mattermod.mobility.gravity_skate.d: Running builds to twice sprint speed. Swings and flings carry into the run.
trait.mattermod.mobility.airwalk.desc: Walk off a ledge onto a glass floor. Jump drops it; tap Sneak to step down, hold to fall.
trait.mattermod.cultivation.badge.desc: Unlocks [color=#31E920]Growth Mode[/color]. Harvest ripe crops 3x3; pollen grows plants and poisons foes. Sneak-Beam tills. Farmland is never trampled.
trait.mattermod.cultivation.overgrowth.d: Harvests spread to all connected ripe crops of the same kind.
trait.mattermod.cultivation.herder.desc: Sneak-Beam feeds animals from your inventory.
trait.mattermod.cultivation.cross_pollin: Harvesting grows nearby young crops a stage.
